---

**What are you trying to do?**
Describe the situation — "I'm looking for X but I can't remember whether it's in Y or Z…"

**What would help?**
The feature or change you have in mind.

**Anything else?**
Alternatives you've tried, other apps that do this well, screenshots.

> Where's principles: local-first, private by default, no required AI, never
> changes your files without asking. Ideas that fit these are easiest to accept.
